pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-02.png with Read and looked at it. Four panels: wide top, two in the middle row, wide bottom.
pages.observation: My reading order was: top-left caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.', top-right label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic', middle-left 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.', middle-right 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.', then the 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' label, then bottom 'One team. Better coordination.'. Tails: the middle-left tail reaches the doctor's head. The middle-right tail is long, but it clearly ends at the small standing receptionist holding a phone. The bottom tail is short and points to the doctor at left, not to the receptionist at right. Coverage: in panel 1 the bottom edge of the top-left caption touches or very slightly clips the top of the doctor's hair, but not her face. In panel 3 the 'WELBUK CARE' label covers the receptionist's legs and lower dress; her face and the phone in her hand stay visible. Laptop, phone and hands are clear elsewhere. Mild confusion: in panel 1 the 'WELBUK PRACTICE' label floats in a corner with no direct link to the laptop, so a reader may not see at once that it names the software on screen. Optional, not blocking.
